summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and the thin ignite handler adapters as specified. Changes are in monai/data/csv_saver.py and nifti_saver.py (new), nifti_writer.py (dtype default), img2tensorboard.py, and the segmentation, classification, and tensorboard handlers. Renamed callers (output_dir) updated in tests/integration_sliding_window.py and two segmentation examples. Tests added: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py now passes filename. Nothing was run, per instructions, and flake8 was not run; line length, trailing whitespace, and end-of-file newlines were checked by search only. No commit made. Not covered: a TensorBoard index test and Sphinx docs for the new modules.
